affine.description: A homogeneous affine matrix stored as a list of rows: 3x3 for a 2D transformation, 4x4 for a 3D transformation. It acts on column vectors: entry [i][j] of the upper-left block is the contribution of input axis j to output axis i, with axes in their declared order, and the last column is the translation. The bottom row is [0, 0, 1] or [0, 0, 0, 1], and all entries are finite. A 3x3 matrix is always a 2D transformation; a 3D rotation or linear block is embedded in a 4x4 matrix.

coordinate_transformations.description: Named coordinate transformations for this image. The transformation named array_to_physical is the image frame. It maps the coordinate system named array (axes x, y and z by position, of type array, in pixel) to the one named physical (of type space, in angstrom). It is a Sequence of an optional Rot90, an optional Reflection, a Translation and a Scale, in that order and each at most once, so that physical = diag(scale) (F R index + translation). The translation is in pixels along the oriented axes, and the scale is the pixel or voxel spacing in angstrom along the final axes. A missing step means no rotation, no reflection, zero translation or unit spacing. Other named transformations are not restricted.

coordinate_transformations.description: Named coordinate transformations for this image. The transformation named array_to_physical is the image frame. It maps the coordinate system named array (axes x, y and z by position, of type array, in pixel) to the one named physical (of type space, in angstrom). It is a Sequence of an optional Rot90, an optional Reflection, a Translation and a Scale, in that order and each at most once, so that physical = diag(scale) (F R index + translation). The translation is in pixels along the oriented axes, and the scale is the pixel or voxel spacing in angstrom along the final axes. A missing step means no rotation, no reflection, zero translation or unit spacing. Other named transformations are not restricted.
